choice: install.sh checks the key by piping it to `cmux-linear-sidebar --check-key` and stores it with `security -i` reading commands on stdin, as the generic password 'cmux-linear-sidebar'. The helper reads LINEAR_API_KEY or the Keychain, after it already listens, because the Keychain may wait on an unlock prompt.
context: A public tool: the key must not sit in files, logs or process lists.
rejected: A .env file in the repository (used during development; plaintext, removed); baking the key into an app bundle's Info.plist (the ExtensionKit probe); `security add-generic-password -w KEY` (the key shows in ps).
title: Keep the Linear API key in the login Keychain
